map.面板堆石坝沉降预测 使用指南: Concrete face rockfill dam settlement prediction guide
map.输入坝高、压缩模量、填筑容重、沉降系数与预测时间，按分层总和法与指数固结模型预测: Enter dam height, compression modulus, fill unit weight, settlement coefficient and prediction time to forecast construction-period settlement, post-construction settlement, total settlement and settlement stabilization time by the layerwise summation method and an exponential consolidation model
map.施工期沉降（分层总和法）Sc = Σ[γ·z_i ÷ (E×1000)] × d: Construction-period settlement (layerwise summation) Sc = sum[gamma*z_i / (E x 1000)] x dz, z_i = (i - 0.5) x dz, dz = H/n; post-construction final settlement S_inf = alpha x 10^-3 x H; settlement at time t: St = S_inf x (1 - e^(-c*t)); total settlement S = Sc + St; settlement rate = S / H x 100%; stabilization time t_st = -ln(1 - threshold ratio) / c; face slab deflection = St x beta
map.面板堆石坝沉降分施工期与竣工后两部分：施工期按分层总和法，将坝体沿高度分为 n: Concrete face rockfill dam settlement splits into construction-period and post-construction parts: the construction period uses the layerwise summation method, dividing the dam body into n layers by height, dividing each layer's vertical stress gamma*z by the compression modulus for strain, multiplying by layer thickness and summing; post-construction follows an exponential consolidation model where final settlement is proportional to dam height (coefficient alpha per mille) and settlement at any time approaches it by the 1 - e^(-ct) increment. The total settlement rate is total settlement over dam height, and the post-construction and total settlement rates are commonly held within 0.5% and 1.0% respectively.
map.填写「面板挠度系数 β」。: Fill in "face slab deflection coefficient beta".
map.填筑期与蓄水期分层沉降估算。: Layered settlement estimation for the filling and impoundment periods.
map.面板脱空与周边缝变形预警。: Early warning of face slab voids and perimeter joint deformation.
map.监测数据反演压缩模量。: Back-calculate the compression modulus from monitoring data.
map.：坝高 150 m、分层压缩率约 1%、分 21 层 → 总沉降 ≈ 150×0: : dam height 150 m with about 1% layered compression ratio over 21 layers -> total settlement about 150 x 0.01, about 1.5 m, so leave margin for the face slab.
map.：蓄水后水下部分附加沉降约 0.2~0.5 m，纳入周边缝变形设计。: : after impoundment the submerged part adds about 0.2-0.5 m of settlement, which is included in the perimeter joint deformation design.
map.沉降影响面板？: Does settlement affect the face slab?
map.过大或不均沉降致面板脱空、周边缝张开，是防渗关键风险。: Excessive or uneven settlement causes face slab voids and opening of the perimeter joint, a key seepage-control risk.
map.弱风化料、薄层碾压、上游设垫层，配合监测预警。: Use weakly weathered material, thin-layer compaction and an upstream cushion layer, together with monitoring and early warning.
